text:
Recovers a Key-ValueStorage.
RecoverKeyValueStorage allows to recover a Key-Value Storage when the redundancy checks
fail.
It will fail with kResourceBusy when the Key-Value Storage is currently open, or when it is
modified by a call from another thread to UpdatePersistency, CleanUpPersistency, Reset
Persistency, RecoverKeyValueStorage, or ResetKeyValueStorage.
This method does a best-effort recovery of all key-value pairs. After recovery, keys might show
outdated or initial value, or might be lost.
